title: HW3
subtitle: 組合數 C(n, k)、讀寫檔案的計算機、讀檔找最高總分、數列的第 y 個數
grading: Q1~Q4 各 25 分，共 100 分；每題 10 組測資、每組 2.5 分

problems.name: Combination
problems.requirement: 要用題目給的 factorial 函式計算，並用迴圈重複讀到正確的 k、n 為止
problems.statement:
Combination: use the given recursive factorial(x) to compute C(n, k) = n! / (k!(n-k)!), where k, n and the result are positive integers, 0 < k < n. k and n are input in one line separated by a space, in the order k n. Check 0 < k < n until the user inputs correct k and n; the program CANNOT be interrupted by any input error.
k > n  -> Error! k > n, please input again!
k = n  -> Error! k = n, please input again!
k <= 0 -> Error! k <= 0, please input again!
n <= 0 -> Error! n <= 0, please input again!
If there are multiple errors, output them in the above order.

tests.note: 最小的合法輸入 k = 1、n = 2 -> 2
k = n - 1，n - k = 1，factorial(1) 是遞迴的終點 -> 10

tests.expected:
Error! k > n, please input again!
220
tests.note: k > n 先報錯、重新輸入後才算 -> 220；只讀一次就結束的程式會漏掉答案

tests.expected:
Error! k = n, please input again!
35
tests.note: k = n 要報錯（不是 k > n）-> 35
k = 0 是 k <= 0 的邊界，要報錯；寫成 k < 0 會讓 0 通過並算出 1（或遞迴爆掉）

tests.expected:
Error! k = n, please input again!
Error! k <= 0, please input again!
Error! n <= 0, please input again!
6
tests.note: k = n 而且兩個都 <= 0：三行錯誤要全部依序印出 -> 6；用 elif 只會印第一行

tests.expected:
Error! k > n, please input again!
Error! n <= 0, please input again!
20
tests.note: k > n 和 n <= 0 同時成立（n = 0 是邊界），依序印兩行 -> 20

tests.expected:
Error! k > n, please input again!
Error! k <= 0, please input again!
Error! n <= 0, please input again!
70
tests.note: -5 > -9 所以也是 k > n，三個錯誤依「k > n、k <= 0、n <= 0」的順序 -> 70

tests.expected:
Error! k > n, please input again!
Error! k = n, please input again!
Error! k <= 0, please input again!
137846528820
tests.note: 連續三次錯誤（k > n；k = n；k <= 0）才輸入正確 -> 137846528820，結果超過 32 位元

problems.name: Extended Simple Calculator
problems.requirement: 要用 try / except 處理檔案、格式、計算的例外
problems.statement: Extended Simple Calculator: the input is "input file name,output file name" in one line. Read "number1 operator number2" (separated by spaces; numbers may be float; operators + - * /) from the input file and write the whole calculated result (e.g. 2, 3.187343, 78.63) to the output file. If successful, show "Successfully". Errors shown on the screen: File not found / Operator error / Cannot divide by zero / Operator lost (number1 number2) / Number1 lost (operator number2) / Number2 lost (number1 operator). "Execution completed" is always shown at the end. If the result cannot be calculated, the output file is still generated but empty.

tests.note: 負數與減法：-7 - 12 = -19；全部轉成 float 會寫成 -19.0；用 isdigit() 判斷數字會把 -7 當成不是數字
整數相除但結果有小數 7 / 2 = 3.5；用 // 會得 3
兩個數字都是小數 1.5 * 2.25 = 3.375；用 int() 轉數字會出錯
結果要寫完整的計算結果 10 / 3 = 3.3333333333333335，不可以四捨五入到兩位

tests.expected:
File not found
Execution completed
=== out_missing.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: 輸入檔不存在 -> File not found + Execution completed；輸出檔仍然要產生（空檔案）

tests.expected:
Operator error
Execution completed
=== op_mod_out.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: % 不是 + - * / -> Operator error；輸出檔是空的，不可以印 Successfully

tests.expected:
Cannot divide by zero
Execution completed
=== zero_out.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: 除以 0 -> Cannot divide by zero（要接住 ZeroDivisionError），輸出檔是空的

tests.expected:
Operator lost
Execution completed
=== no_op_out.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: 只有 number1 number2 -> Operator lost

tests.expected:
Number1 lost
Execution completed
=== no_num1_out.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: 只有 operator number2 -> Number1 lost；和 Number2 lost 搞反會錯

tests.expected:
Number2 lost
Execution completed
=== no_num2_out.txt（空檔案）===
tests.note: 只有 number1 operator -> Number2 lost；Execution completed 不管有沒有錯都要印

problems.name: Calculate and Search
problems.statement: Calculate and Search: the input is a .txt file name (utf-8). The first line is N (1 <= N <= 100); lines 2 to N+1 are "No. score1 score2 score3" separated by a space (integers >= 0). Print the No. of the student with the highest total score and the total, separated by a comma. There is only one highest total score.

tests.note: N = 1 而且三科都是 0 -> 7,0；最高分的初始值設成 0 又用 > 比較，會找不到人
最高總分是第一位學生 -> 1,280；只記最後一位或從第二位開始比都會錯
最高總分是最後一位 -> 6,288；range(1, N) 少讀一行會漏掉他
學號不是 1、2、3… 要印檔案裡的 No.（305），不是第幾行
單科最高（第 1 號第一科 100 分）不是總分最高 -> 3,255；只比第一科會錯
要三科加總：只加前兩科會選到第 1 號（190），正確是 2,245
總分只差 1 分（241 vs 240），最高在中間 -> 3,241
題目只說分數是 >= 0 的整數，沒說上限：總分 1200 的同學 -> 2,1200

problems.name: Loop and Condition
problems.statement: Loop and Condition: x and y in one line separated by a space (positive integers). x is the first number of a series and y is a location. If the number is odd, multiply it by 5 and then minus 3; if it is even, divide it by 2 and then add 1. Print the number at location y (location = index + 1).

tests.note: y = 1：一步都不用走，直接印 x -> 7；迴圈多跑一次會印 32
10 -> 6 -> 4，連續兩次偶數規則，用 / 會印 4.0
數字會先變大到 2082 再掉回來，第 14 個是 132
2 是固定點，位置 100 還是 2；迴圈次數多也不能出錯
起始值是三位數的奇數，走 29 步
